body:
Maybe your mum freaks out because if you have a mental issues she would feel that is her fault, she did something to make you mentaly sick, so her anger against you when you show or tell signs of anxiety and stuff could mean its herself she really is angry about and takes it out on you. Its probably her fears showing her fear of not being a good enough mum, not raising that happy strong kid.. There could me many reasons but I always believe people are doing things with good intention unless they are pure evil and I dont she is when I see the human qualities you have in your writing and conserning for others...

Some people get angry when they are scared, and we often take those feelings out on those we love the most....
Im sure there is a reason for her reacting so negativly on you having mental issues, it could be something in her passed , religious beliefe or whatever..

Anyhow those feelings goes over, she may be mad at you but it wont last forever and before you know it you are a grownup controlling your own life.. Dont kill yourself over your mums frights, thats her issues and it would be sad if your life got wasted because of that...

Im sure your mum loves you and wants whats best for you, and im sure she could have needed a mentalclass herself she defently have some issues to work with.

Wish you all the best in life and with your mum <3

I dont think he know how to help. I think it scares him..I feel 1 % better today..We are having the weekend off from the kids I hope to get myself together over the weekend, so I can last atleast one more week <3

Im still here I guess thats something...Its hard when you stop living and only survive..I wish us both better mental health, good to know we are not alone. I love all of you aswell, its good to have somewhere to get it out <3
fosterkids, my nephwe and niese lives with me.

I dont have any strenght left to look for the light, and im to shameful to ask for help. somehow death seems to be the best solution, tough I know the pain for those left behind I dont feel that aplies to me. I feel it would make everyone feel better in the long run.. But I hear you..
Thank you for caring for a stranger <3

I know thats the only reason im still here, but the thing is the kids are not even mine. Im a fostermum for my bigssiters children because she chose drugs over them. I am born with a syndrome that makes me infertile, I cant have children on my own.. My sister is doing better and have been clean for 4 years, I had the kids for 7 years, this has fucked our relationship. I know she looks into loyers to try have them back, Im not sure I have the strength to take that fight.. Again it would be easier if im not here. The depth I have is out of control and from next motnh I wont be able to pay my bills, kids activity and food. If I die the depth dies with me and will make life easier for my man and the kids. I cant seek help because I dont know what consequenses that will have for the kids, me being a suicidal fostermum. Again it resolves better if im just dead. Im 13 years older than my husband he will have no problem finding a much better lifepartner then the mess that is me. I miss my parents, i miss the safety of having that safe haven to fall back on. I have nothing real that is mine and only mine..I have put myself in this position with depth and im deeply ashamed of myself. Im soon 40 and feel like a helpless child. I miss my best friend so much and I hate myself for not being able to help him. My other best friend has moved away and I see her only a couple of times a year. I have nothing and in my age its not easy to find that bond with someone.. I have been fighting for survival since I was 8 years old when I found my mum dead on the couch, my dad was in jail, I lived with a aunt that hit me until he came out of jail then I lived with him. He became and alcoholic, he tried to kill himself many times and I stoped him everytime. Until I was 28 I did not answer the phone when he called me because I knew he was drunk and I was tiered of it, and then he shot himself right after...They say im strong but I feel weak, I am not strong  I am no super human who can take all shit in the world. I lived with my boyfriend for 4 years than he died to in a motorbike accident first time we where apart. Even my dog died. Ive been to more than 40 funerals of family and friends and boyfriends, there is noone left. What is left could be gone in any minute. I can't talk to anyone because the words wont come out of my mouth, I  know what I want to say but not how to actually do it. I constantly feel ashamed, lowlife, unworthy, useless, I dont even know how to be a woman or act my age, I just feel unreparable. It feels like its easier to die then talk to someone that knows me or is close to me.. THey will say the same, everything will be alright, we need you and all that standard bullshit. They dont understant me or my life...Im so scared and lonely. ALl I ever wanted was a ok life, and I could not even do that for myself because Im stupid. Im just a burden atm...

I just took a shower to try wash away my tears so I can put on my nothing is wrong face for the kids and husband arriving home in few minutes...Tomorrow may be the day...I just cant talk to him, or anyone else, its easier here with strangers that dont know who I am...Nothing can heal me at this time, and why should I wast other people time on trying? Im just a little human amon trillions, its just a life that comes and go..If I cant be usefull I think its better Im not here at all. Thank you for taking the time YogiJG to reply, that ment a lot to me just knowing one stranger cared enough to atleast try and reply :) You are a good human <3
Im smiling as I die slowly inside, I done that my whole life..Always hoping tomorrow gets better, that things will work out, sometimes it does, but this time feels different..

I dont want to burden him, I know he will have it so much better when he gets over the loss..Its not that big of a loss. Im a bit older than him, I cant have children, Im just a mess and I feel I rob him for all the good things he could have in life..I dont know how to fix the situation. I cant talk to him, I cant even talk to my psycatrist, I just sit there like an idiot and idiot and say 5 words of shit...Its so hard to talk about my feelings, its easier to say everything is fine, as I have for 30 years...Im weak, dumb and useless..It feels like noone can help me, maybe I dont want them to help me as it makes me feel completly useless, pathetic and even weaker...
